commands.description: Add archvow specs and guards to a repository (no source folders).

parameters.name: package
parameters.help: snake_case Python package the code will live in (also the project name)

parameters.name: template
parameters.help: architecture template: <pack>/<template>, or its short name when one pack only has it (default: archvow/python-app; list: archvow catalog); a company template comes in a pack: archvow pack add <folder> first

parameters.name: description
parameters.help: what the system does, in one line: goes into the vow, the README and every spec card (default: the package name)

parameters.name: answer
parameters.help: answer one of the template's questions (repeatable); the keys are listed below

parameters.name: dir
parameters.help: repository root (default: current folder)

parameters.name: src
parameters.help: source root (default: src)

parameters.name: force
parameters.help: in a folder that is already a project: rewrite the generated files from the template (AGENTS.md, CI, hooks...). A committed spec is always kept; to start over, git rm -r .archvow and commit

parameters.name: no_git
parameters.help: do not create a Git repository (default: one is created, branch main)

parameters.name: no_input
parameters.help: never ask: in a terminal, init asks the main questions no -a answered (scripts and CI are never asked)

parameters.name: adopt
parameters.help: existing code: propose `layer_paths` from folder and file names (core, models, crud, services, api...) so the files stay where they are; written into .archvow/spec.vow and printed for the architects to review (with --force in a project: adds the files not mapped yet)

commands.description: List templates, their init answers and component types.

parameters.help: component type (listed below)

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: short snake_case name; the type turns it into the component id (below)

parameters.name: description
parameters.help: what the component must do - the instruction the AI assistant or developer implements, with the details that matter (change it with archvow component edit)

parameters.name: spec
parameters.help: ticket or user story it implements, e.g. US-001

parameters.name: uses
parameters.help: comma-separated ids of the components it uses

parameters.name: kind
parameters.help: for the types that have kinds (listed below): what it reads or writes, e.g. a reader of files (the default), a table, a database (jdbc), a connector or custom code; fixed once added (remove and add again to change it)

parameters.name: signature
parameters.help: replace the public function's signature (only for the types that allow it, listed below; e.g. a second input)

parameters.name: container
parameters.help: container id, when the project has several (default: the first)

parameters.name: group
parameters.help: a folder inside the layer, to organise many components, e.g. orders: <layer>/orders/<file>.py and tests/<layer>/orders/test_<id>.py

parameters.name: route
parameters.help: for a router: one route, "<function>: <METHOD> <path>" (repeatable), e.g. "get_order: GET /orders/{order_id}"

parameters.name: source
parameters.help: the brief it is drawn from: briefs/<file>.md, or briefs/<file>.md#<section> (a heading); archvow check warns when that text changes (ARCH039)
